scope: Native EX/CC Dense/Sparse construction/views/additive/scalar arithmetic; complete stock QQ linprog preparation; guarded nonfinite substitution and extended-domain preservation; shared scalar Vector/Tensor dispatcher protocol

source_identity.scope: Code, tests, audit fixtures, package configuration and native binary; documentation excluded

remaining_gaps: No global algorithmic parity certification. Full documentation-example and ODE/integration corpus replay remains open.

Sparse EX/CC general multiplication/square/power still use the complete dense path in this release; a separately validated recursive sparse product patch is pending integration. Other nonported dense algorithms can remain costly at huge coordinates.
Raw EX nonstructural zero annotations retain the dense representation. The old public interior Float-zero precision gap is not claimed fixed.

Guarded substitution scope is conjunctive negative Complexes-membership predicates and supported parameter/function-value substitutions. Ordinary arithmetic and arbitrary algebraic pattern substitution are not globally changed.
Undefined NaN under the guard is retained as a held equation. Tautological guards can remain visible to preserve later substitutions; this is an explicit presentation difference.
Full QQ linprog preparation only selects stock exact inputs and safe canonical scalar dispatch chains. Other domains, alias/protocol/converter cases retain the prior complete algorithms.
Dense DomainMatrix multiplication/rref and the limited ordinary noncommutative zero/infinity correction are separate ports, not included in570f.
